baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Form V recall verb at word 2 governs the relative object completed by the striving verb at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recollection restores material absent from awareness, while the work-and-acquisition branch of the final verb identifies that material as the human's accumulated activity.

activation_trace.role: Restoration after forgetting supplies the operative act of bringing the past back into awareness.
Work, earning, and conduct supply the accumulated record that the relative clause gathers.

changed_reading.before: The human recalls something about the past.
changed_reading.after: The human re-presents his own accumulated deeds and earnings, whether good or bad, as the object of recall.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open relative at word 4 and the motion-oriented striving verb at word 5 can retain both effort and the object toward which effort moved.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful movement toward a sought object makes the remembered unit a trajectory of aims, exertion, and direction rather than only a list of completed acts.

activation_trace.role: Directed movement toward a desired end supplies the trajectory carried by the remembered striving.
Re-presentation in the heart makes the whole prior trajectory simultaneously available for review.

changed_reading.before: The human remembers the acts he performed.
changed_reading.after: The human remembers what he kept moving toward: his aims, chosen direction, and the effort spent along that path.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal noun at word 1 frames the recall clause, and the recall root at word 2 also carries reminder language.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening temporal expression can denote a severe descending occurrence, so the event is not merely when recollection happens but the condition that makes dormant striving present.

activation_trace.role: A momentous and severe occurrence turns the temporal frame into an activating crisis.
A reminder that restores presence lets the event itself function as the summons to recall.

changed_reading.before: Memory occurs on a neutral future date.
changed_reading.after: The overwhelming occasion itself forces the human's previously dormant striving into awareness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence supplies a worked causal instance of striving: an initial crossing of limits becomes turning away, mobilizing a public, and culminating in self-exaltation. The focus can therefore recall an extended project whose stages disclose its governing direction.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement supplies the focus anchor for reading striving as an unfolding directed project.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the project's initiating moral direction.
Turning one's back and withdrawing supplies the pivot immediately joined to the contextual act of striving.
Driving and gathering a group toward a goal supplies the striving project's social extension.
Self-magnification and tyranny supply the trajectory's declared culmination.

structural_cues: The focus striving lexeme recurs exactly at 79:22 inside the 79:17-24 verb chain.
The narrative orders transgression, turning away while striving, gathering, calling, and a climactic claim before presenting punishment as a lesson.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered actions and the exact striving recurrence; I treat that chain as a worked example of what later recollection can replay. It may instead be one historical example without defining every human's remembered striving.

changed_reading.before: The human remembers an undifferentiated total of deeds.
changed_reading.after: The human replays a directed project in causal sequence, from the orientation that launched it through the people mobilized and the claim it sought to establish.

context_deltas.mechanism: A renewed report becomes a deterrent example, is explicitly transferred as a lesson from one case to another, and closes as warning that awakens caution. Final recollection can thus be the delayed completion of reminders already planted during life.

activation_trace.role: Reminder language anchors a model in which earlier prompts become fully effective at the focus moment.
A report renewed in speech supplies memorable historical material rather than bare information.
Punishment that deters observers gives the report prospective force for someone other than its first subject.
Transferring one condition into a lesson for another makes the Pharaoh report a reusable memory prompt.
A warning that arouses caution supplies the final prospective trigger whose neglected content returns in recall.

structural_cues: The 79:15-26 historical report is labeled a transferable lesson, while 79:45 closes the surah's address by defining a warning function.
The remembrance family reappears at 79:43 between the focus recollection and the closing warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, exemplary deterrence, lesson, and warning; I infer that these seed the later recollection of one's response. They may primarily address the present audience rather than describe the psychology of 79:35.

changed_reading.before: The human spontaneously retrieves a sealed private record only at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The human finally recognizes both his striving and the warnings and examples that had already made its direction knowable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence offers a process analogy for recollection: settled material is pulled out, the operation reaches comprehensively, and what was knotted is released. The deed record is not calmly consulted but forcibly made retrievable in full.

activation_trace.role: Recovery after absence anchors the extraction analogy in the focus act of recollection.
The accumulated work record supplies the latent material on which the retrieval process operates.
Pulling something from its settled place supplies the first stage of forced retrieval.
Comprehensive engulfing supplies total scope, leaving no part of the striving record outside recall.
A knot made and released supplies the image of previously bound material becoming accessible.

structural_cues: The opening two lines intensify their roots through paired noun forms before the surah moves into the event-day sequence.
The focus uses a reflexive recall form, leaving room for an internally experienced retrieval process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extraction, comprehensive reach, and knot release; I map their sequence onto memory retrieval. The live alternative is that these images describe resurrection processes only and do not characterize recollection itself.

changed_reading.before: Recollection is an effortless mental lookup.
changed_reading.after: The entire deed archive is pulled from latency and unbound until the human can no longer keep any portion inaccessible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The event brings matters into presence, hidden reality is uncovered for sight, and the nearby choosing root also carries the branch of a surviving mark that indicates what happened. Recollection becomes inspection of an exposed evidentiary trace of striving.

activation_trace.role: Restoring what had receded from awareness anchors the conversion from private recall to present evidence.
Work and acquisition supply the conduct whose traces are exposed.
Bringing something and making it present supplies the transition from latency to confrontation.
Appearance through uncovering supplies public disclosure rather than inward memory alone.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the mode by which the disclosed record is apprehended.
A surviving mark that indicates what was supplies an evidentiary residue left by preference and conduct.

structural_cues: The focus is placed directly between the event's arrival at 79:34 and visual exposure at 79:36.
The outcome clauses immediately afterward identify prior preference and restraint as discriminating facts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies presentation, uncovering, sight, and a surviving-mark branch; I link external exposure to the focus's interior recollection. The explicit exposed object is the blaze, and the surface at 79:38 primarily expresses preference, so the evidentiary linkage remains abductive.

changed_reading.before: The human privately remembers past activity.
changed_reading.after: The human confronts his striving as a visible, surviving choice-trace that now functions as evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired outcomes expose the generative structure behind deeds: crossing a boundary and preferring one life stand opposite restraining action within the self against its inclination. What is remembered includes the preference-and-restraint system that produced outward striving.

activation_trace.role: Directed movement anchors the question of which inward orientation governed the human's course.
Going beyond the limit in disobedience supplies one governing orientation of striving.
Preferential choice supplies the selection that channels conduct toward one valued life.
Checking and preventing an act supplies active counter-direction rather than mere absence of misconduct.
The inward rational and affective field supplies the site in which restraint is exercised.
The self's inclination supplies the directional pressure either followed or opposed.

structural_cues: The matched alternatives at 79:37-41 follow immediately after the focus and classify outcomes by prior orientation, preference, fear, and restraint.
The negative side names transgression plus preference; the positive side names fear plus an enacted check on desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two opposed action clusters; I infer a causal arrow from preference or restraint to the striving later remembered. The alternative is that these are only summary criteria for destination, not a decomposition of memory's object.

changed_reading.before: The human remembers a countable ledger of external acts.
changed_reading.after: The human remembers the inward selections that generated the ledger: what he preferred, which limits he crossed, and where he restrained his own inclination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purposeful motion in the focus is followed by two opposed clauses of joining a shelter, then by the hour's anchorage and endpoint. The remembered striving can be read as a cumulative route whose direction is finally disclosed by where it comes to rest.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement toward an object supplies the route whose destination is later disclosed.
Joining a side that gathers and shelters supplies one terminal lodging for the route.
The repeated joining-and-sheltering image supplies the opposed terminal lodging without changing the route mechanism.
A vessel stopping at anchorage supplies the image of motion reaching fixed rest.
The limit at which something ends supplies the terminal boundary of the remembered course.

structural_cues: The two outcome blocks repeat the same shelter predicate at 79:39 and 79:41 after contrasting orientations.
Questions about the event's anchorage and endpoint immediately follow those destination clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed motion, opposed shelters, anchorage, and endpoint; I infer that accumulated direction and final lodging form one route. The alternative is a juridical assignment of outcomes rather than a journey generated by striving.

changed_reading.before: The human remembers effort as activity already left behind.
changed_reading.after: The human recognizes his striving as a route whose accumulated direction has now reached and disclosed its abiding destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence gives the event an anchorage and endpoint, then compresses the experienced prior stay into an evening or a forenoon. The focus day becomes a terminal present in which a lifetime of striving is cognitively condensed into one reviewable whole.

activation_trace.role: A bounded duration supplies the focus frame that the closing comparisons radically rescale.
Re-presenting the past supplies the cognitive act through which the compressed lifetime becomes a single whole.
Anchorage after motion supplies a fixed terminal now from which prior time is viewed.
The endpoint of a thing supplies temporal closure rather than an ordinary calendar date.
Dwelling for a span supplies the duration that is retrospectively diminished.
The evening interval supplies one compact measure for the apparently long prior stay.
The forenoon's limited extension supplies the alternate compact measure of lived duration.

structural_cues: The focus day at 79:35 is echoed by another day-expression at 79:46, where seeing the event alters the estimate of elapsed time.
Anchorage, endpoint, sight, and compressed dwelling close the whole-surah temporal arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terminality and explicit duration compression; I infer that this compression shapes the totalizing mode of recollection. The alternative is that 79:46 estimates worldly duration without describing how the memory in 79:35 operates.

changed_reading.before: A future day is simply the date on which separate memories return.
changed_reading.after: At the terminal present, the apparent length of life collapses and its entire striving can be grasped as one concentrated whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the human noun ordinarily denotes the person, whereas the cited focus branch concerns the human image in the pupil. It remains anchored to word 3 and is activated by the surah's eye-and-seeing sequence; render it only as an optical analogy for self-confrontation, never as a replacement lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The human noun at word 3 has a branch involving the human figure seen within the eye, adjacent in syntax to the act of recall.

activation_trace.role: The human figure reflected in the pupil supplies an optical self-image for the remembering subject.
Recovered presence supplies the mental content that the optical analogy places before the self.
Physical sight supplies the earlier eye-frame that activates the pupil-image branch.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the later act of direct confrontation.

changed_reading.before: A human subject internally recalls his deeds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, recollection is staged like seeing one's own human image held before the eye: the subject becomes witness to himself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the focus root's non-dominant mapped target and its recurrence under the hour root, so it is branch-distant and must not displace the ordinary purposeful sense of striving. It remains packet-anchored at word 5 and usefully exposes a counter-reading: apparent effort may prove to have been neglected, dissipated motion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The striving occurrence at word 5 resolves both to its dominant purposeful-motion inventory and to the packet's non-dominant mapped target for ungoverned going.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful movement supplies the dominant reading against which the outlier operates.
Neglect that lets something go on its own course supplies the packet-authorized counter-image within the focus occurrence.
The same mapped branch under the hour occurrence reactivates ungoverned drift near the surah's temporal close.

changed_reading.before: All remembered striving is coherent, deliberate progress toward a chosen goal.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the human also recognizes where supposed striving was really neglect: energy released to wander, dissipate, or carry him without governance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant mapped target attached to the preference root, making it more distant than the dominant choice and trace branches. It remains anchored through focus recollection and the adjacent disclosure sequence; downstream prose should mark it as a process analogy in which latent memory bursts into manifestness, not as the lexical sense of the contextual verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recall verb at word 2 supplies emergence from prior absence, while the focus stands between arrival and exposure.

activation_trace.role: Re-presentation after absence supplies the latent-to-present transition.
Outward eruption and visible spread supply the surprising dynamics of memory becoming manifest.
Uncovering into appearance supplies the public field into which the latent record emerges.

changed_reading.before: Remembering remains a contained inward mental event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the buried record erupts into outward manifestness, making recollection an event of unavoidable disclosure.

strongest_changes: The Pharaoh sequence turns remembered striving from an undifferentiated deed total into a causal project with moral direction, social reach, and a culminating claim.
Placement between arrival and exposure, reinforced by the surviving-mark branch, changes recollection into confrontation with visible evidence of prior choice.
The paired outcomes show that the remembered object includes preference, boundary-crossing, inward inclination, and enacted self-restraint, not external acts alone.
The closing anchorage, endpoint, and compressed stay make the focus day a terminal present that condenses a lifetime into one reviewable trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation was decisive: the exact striving lexeme in the Pharaoh chain supplied a narrative instance, the post-focus choice pair supplied motive structure and destination, and split mapped roots preserved controlled outliers of drift and eruption that a conservative synthesis would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening extraction-and-untying model may describe resurrection processes without transferring to memory mechanics.
The degree to which the open relative lets the final striving verb foreground pursued goals as well as performed deeds remains syntactically live.
The surviving-mark use of the preference root and both non-dominant split-root outliers should remain qualified rather than govern the surface reading.
